text: DSH Skin Studio · Desktop 是面向 DSH 桌面客户端的界面皮肤工作室。它通过设置页入口和界面覆盖层提供可视化编辑器，并在客户端应用皮肤。用户可以创建和管理皮肤，调整明暗调色板与界面令牌，设置壁纸、组件媒体、字体、品牌图片和文案，还能预览更改并保存或取消。皮肤可打包为 .dshskin 文件导入和导出，适合希望定制 DSH 桌面界面并分享主题的用户。安装需在 Windows DSH 桌面环境运行附带安装器；无需额外 API 密钥。

DSH Skin Studio · Desktop customizes DSH with editable palettes, tokens, wallpaper, media, fonts, and branding. Preview, save, or cancel changes, then import or export .dshskin themes to share them. Install with the included Windows desktop installer; no API key is needed.
我想把 DSH 桌面界面的颜色和主题改成自己喜欢的样子

我想为 DSH 做一套自定义外观并在桌面客户端预览
怎样把做好的界面皮肤打包分享给另一台电脑？
想改掉欢迎页和侧边栏上的图片、提示文字
I want to create and switch between custom looks for the DSH desktop app.
Can I export a theme with its images and import it on another machine?
I need to customize the colors, typography, and wallpaper across the desktop interface.
DSH Skin Studio · Desktop 的功能「创建与管理皮肤」：在设置中的工作室打开皮肤库，可创建、编辑、复制、激活或恢复内置皮肤；预览可保存应用，也可取消并恢复先前外观。
DSH Skin Studio · Desktop 的功能「调整界面外观」：在编辑器中修改明暗模式调色板和高级界面令牌，并设置壁纸、组件媒体与字体；选择皮肤后，客户端将对应令牌和媒体应用到界面。
DSH Skin Studio · Desktop 的功能「定制界面图片和文案」：通过语义槽位替换欢迎区、侧边栏和工作区图标等图片，也能改写部分固定文案及选定文本；编辑器提供目标选择和即时应用。
DSH Skin Studio · Desktop 的功能「导入和导出皮肤包」：在包页面导出包含皮肤清单与媒体资源的 .dshskin 文件，或导入文件恢复皮肤；导入时检查清单、资源格式、大小和哈希，并提供冲突处理。

@local/dsh-desktop-skin-studio README · DSH Skin Studio · Desktop：[中文说明](README.zh.md) · [Download](https://github.com/realMisakaMikoto/dsh-skin-studio/releases) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/realMisakaMikoto/dsh-skin-studio/issues)

Create, preview and share complete skins in **DeepSeek Harness for Windows**. This repository now maintains the desktop edition, succeeding the deprecated WebUI-only 0.6.0-alpha.1.

@local/dsh-desktop-skin-studio README · DSH Skin Studio · Desktop：Tested with **DSH desktop 0.2.0-rc.2**. Other desktop versions and operating systems are not yet verified. Historical WebUI releases remain available in the [release archive](https://github.com/realMisakaMikoto/dsh-skin-studio/releases/tag/0.6.0-alpha.1).

@local/dsh-desktop-skin-studio README · Install：1. Start DSH desktop once to initialize its desktop profile, then save your work and quit it.
2. Install Node.js 22 or newer if `node --version` is unavailable.
3. Download the desktop release's **Source code (zip)** or `.tgz` archive and extract it to a permanent folder.
4. Double-click `install-desktop.cmd`, or run `node scripts/install-desktop.mjs` from that folder.
5. Reopen DSH. Open **Account menu → Settings → General → Custom skins → Open skin studio**.

@local/dsh-desktop-skin-studio README · Install：The source archive includes the prebuilt client and all preset media. No build step is needed to install a release. Keep the extracted folder: your desktop profile links to it. The installer backs up the selected profile, installs this package using DSH's bundled pnpm, and enables it without altering other plugins' settings.

For custom installations:

@local/dsh-desktop-skin-studio README · Install：```sh
node scripts/install-desktop.mjs --profile "D:/DSH/profile" --resources "D:/DSH/resources" --dry-run
node scripts/install-desktop.mjs --profile "D:/DSH/profile" --resources "D:/DSH/resources"
```

The global `dsh plugin --profile desktop add` command may reject desktop profiles because they are managed by Electron; use the included installer.

@local/dsh-desktop-skin-studio README · Install：The desktop edition is also available as [`dsh-skin-studio@0.7.1` on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-skin-studio/v/0.7.1). To download it, run:

```sh
npm pack dsh-skin-studio@0.7.1
tar -xzf dsh-skin-studio-0.7.1.tgz
node package/scripts/install-desktop.mjs
```

@local/dsh-desktop-skin-studio README · Install：Save your work and quit DSH before running the installer. Keep the extracted `package` folder. To update an existing installation, run the installer from the new package and fully restart DSH. Choose either GitHub or npm; disable an earlier local skin studio entry before switching distribution channels. Versions through `0.6.0-alpha.1` remain the historical WebUI edition.

@local/dsh-desktop-skin-studio README · Complete skin editing：| Page | Features |
| --- | --- |
| Library | Create, duplicate, edit, activate, delete and restore DSH defaults |
| Basic editor | Light/dark palettes, OKLCH generation, image/video wallpaper and WOFF2 fonts |
| GUI components | Token groups/search, component picker, per-component media, opacity and blur |
| Visual assets | Five semantic image positions, original/custom previews and sidebar branding |
| Copy | Bilingual fixed copy, structured text targets and input hints |
| Import & export | Portable `.dshskin` v5 packages, resource validation and conflict choices |

@local/dsh-desktop-skin-studio README · Complete skin editing：Seventeen complete presets are bundled: Bright Studio, High Contrast, Tidal Paper, thirteen Nijigasaki character skins and one group skin. Media is included locally. Edited presets survive updates.

@local/dsh-desktop-skin-studio README · Complete skin editing：Edits preview live. **Apply & save** persists and activates the draft; **Cancel preview** restores the previous skin. The editor reports contrast/readability concerns and protects unsaved changes. Pickers support mouse/keyboard, F2 mode switching and Esc return. Visual positions that do not exist in the current view are reported and left unchanged.

@local/dsh-desktop-skin-studio README · Storage and migration：Desktop data lives in the independent `dsh-desktop-skin-studio` IndexedDB namespace. A lightweight localStorage snapshot restores the active skin at startup. The original WebUI database is untouched; use `.dshskin` files to move skins between editions.

@local/dsh-desktop-skin-studio README · Storage and migration：Legacy desktop v1 data upgrades transactionally to v2 with original rows and snapshot retained in `migration-backups`. Unconvertible records remain preserved with visible warnings. Switching skins, restoring defaults, cancelling preview and unloading release media, fonts, observers and object URLs.

@local/dsh-desktop-skin-studio README · Development：```sh
npm ci
npm run verify
npm run verify:client
npm pack

Edit TypeScript/TSX/CSS Modules in `src/`, then run `npm run build`. The lazy `client.js` is generated with tsdown. React comes from the host's platform table; the plugin does not import private Harness Client packages or create a second renderer.

@local/dsh-desktop-skin-studio README · Development：CI verifies Node.js 22/24 on Windows and Linux; desktop runtime support is Windows only. Optional installed-host checks are `npm run check:install`, `npm run asar` and `npm run drift`. Override `DSKIN_RESOURCES_DIR`, `DSKIN_DSH_ROOT`, `DSH_HOME` or `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` for nonstandard locations.

@local/dsh-desktop-skin-studio README · Development：See [runtime notes](docs/runtime-facts.md), [verification history](docs/verification.md), [v5 format](docs/skin-format-v5.md) and [design documentation](DESIGN.md). Report your DSH version, plugin version and reproduction steps with issues.

@local/dsh-desktop-skin-studio README · License：Source is **AGPL-3.0-only**, continuing the original project. Legacy desktop integration retains its MIT notice in `LICENSE.local-MIT`; bundled fflate is MIT. Character artwork and logos have separate rights and attribution in [THIRD_PARTY_ASSETS.md](THIRD_PARTY_ASSETS.md).
